stories.title: Trump says Xi state dinner is ‘a very tough ticket’ as business guest list takes shape

en.title: Trump says Xi state dinner is 'a very tough ticket' as business guest list takes shape
en.summary: Trump stated that the upcoming state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping has extremely limited availability, with space for approximately 125 people despite thousands wanting to attend. Reports indicate that executives from major Chinese companies may be included among the guests.

stories.title: Word to the wise on organising a Chinese leader’s US visit

en.title: Word to the wise on organising a Chinese leader's US visit
en.summary: An account reflecting on the logistical challenges of organizing a Chinese president's state visit to the United States, drawing on the author's experience from a previous such event in 2006.

stories.title: Trump claims US Greenland security deal, China reportedly among adversaries being kept out

en.title: Trump claims US Greenland security deal, China reportedly among adversaries being kept out
en.summary: Trump announced that the United States has secured an agreement with Denmark and Greenland granting permanent US authority over security matters on the Arctic island, with US adversaries including China prohibited from establishing military bases or making sensitive investments there.

stories.title: Trump ‘banning’ CNN, MS Now and Politico from White House

en.title: Trump 'banning' CNN, MS Now and Politico from White House
en.summary: Trump announced an immediate ban on three news outlets from the White House, citing what he characterized as false reporting, a move likely to face legal challenges based on constitutional free speech protections.

stories.title: Princess Diana’s ‘revenge dress’ goes on show amid clash between brother and King Charles

en.title: Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' goes on show amid clash between brother and King Charles
en.summary: Princess Diana's iconic black off-the-shoulder dress was displayed in London, coinciding with renewed discussion about King Charles's response to her death and ongoing tensions within the royal family nearly three decades later.

stories.title: 安理会完成联合国秘书长遴选第三轮意向性投票

en.title: Security Council completes third round of indicative voting on UN Secretary-General selection
en.summary: The UN Security Council completed its third indicative vote on selecting the next Secretary-General on September 18, with results to be communicated to candidates by their nominating countries rather than made public.

stories.title: 国际原子能机构称俄罗斯一核电站冷却塔被无人机击中

en.title: International Atomic Energy Agency says Russian nuclear plant cooling tower struck by drone
en.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency reported that a cooling tower at Russia's Kursk nuclear power station was hit by a drone on September 17.

stories.title: 第23届东博会合作项目集中签约

en.title: 23rd China-ASEAN Expo cooperative projects concentrated signing
en.summary: The 23rd China-ASEAN Expo signing ceremony resulted in 41 projects across 8 cities in the Pinglu Canal economic zone and 19 international cooperation projects covering 7 ASEAN nations.

stories.title: China hawks join forces in US Congress to pressure Trump ahead of Xi’s visit

en.title: China hawks join forces in US Congress to pressure Trump ahead of Xi's visit
en.summary: US lawmakers critical of China increased congressional activity ahead of Chinese President Xi Jinping's expected visit to Washington, holding hearings on human rights, trade, and supply chain issues to influence Trump's agenda.

stories.title: Over 2,000 UK flight cancellations traced to millisecond software defect

en.title: Over 2,000 UK flight cancellations traced to millisecond software defect
en.summary: A millisecond software defect in the National Airspace System caused the cancellation of over 2,000 flights in the United Kingdom on September 8, according to air traffic control authority NATS.

stories.title: Why China is playing it cool amid Trump’s disruption and churn

en.title: Why China is playing it cool amid Trump's disruption and churn
en.summary: An upcoming summit between the US and Chinese presidents in Washington aims to advance their agreement on constructive strategic stability. Chinese officials have expressed frustration with slow decision-making and limited engagement from the US administration leading up to the meeting.

stories.title: Patient who needed soft food dies after choking on regular meal at public hospital

en.title: Patient who needed soft food dies after choking on regular meal at public hospital
en.summary: A 54-year-old patient died at a Hong Kong public hospital after being given a regular meal instead of required soft food, resulting in choking and a heart attack. The hospital has apologized and established an investigation panel to review the incident.

stories.title: China’s crude imports are rising again. What will that mean for oil prices?

en.title: China's crude imports are rising again. What will that mean for oil prices?
en.summary: China is increasing crude oil imports after a period of reduced purchasing during regional tensions, which could affect global oil price stability. However, analysts predict China will not immediately return to pre-conflict import levels due to refinery margin pressures and substantial existing stockpiles.

stories.title: Tesla auditing Chinese suppliers ahead of Optimus roll-out: sources

en.title: Tesla auditing Chinese suppliers ahead of Optimus roll-out: sources
en.summary: Tesla is conducting audits of Chinese suppliers as it prepares to scale up production of its Optimus humanoid robot for global market launch later this year. Multiple Chinese component and parts manufacturers are undergoing these supplier evaluations.

stories.title: Will AI adoption shrink office space? Asia-Pacific firms are on the fence in survey

en.title: Will AI adoption shrink office space? Asia-Pacific firms are on the fence in survey
en.summary: A CBRE survey found that 19% of Asia-Pacific companies believe AI adoption will reduce their office space needs, while 56% remain neutral on the impact and 25% expect increased space requirements.

stories.title: How China plans to ‘firmly rank at the global forefront’ with 25% of first-in-class drugs

en.title: How China plans to 'firmly rank at the global forefront' with 25% of first-in-class drugs
en.summary: China's new five-year plan aims to establish it as a global biomedicine leader by 2030, targeting at least 25% of the world's first-in-class drugs market and major technological breakthroughs.

stories.title: From US Fed rates to China’s global export share: 4 figures shaping markets

en.title: From US Fed rates to China's global export share: 4 figures shaping markets
en.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate by 25 basis points this week, with the Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Bank of Japan following suit, while the 10-year US Treasury yield fell below 5%.
